title: Send or revoke a TTO video linking request
content_data:
Use this endpoint to send a request for linking a creator's public video to a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace campaign, or revoke such a request. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/campaign/link/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{32%}|Type{15%}|Description{53%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by a TikTok One Creator Marketplace account.
For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{32%}|Type{15%}|Description{53%}| |--- |--- |--- | | tto_tcm_account_id {Required} | string | The ID of the TikTok One Creator Marketplace account.

To obtain the IDs of the accounts that you can access via `Access-Token`, use [/tto/oauth2/tcm/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693478150146). | | campaign_id {Required} | string | The ID of an existing TTO Creator Marketplace campaign.

To obtain a list of TTO Creator Marketplace campaigns, use [/tto/tcm/campaign/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693562720258). | | video_id {Required} | string | The ID of a creator's public video to be linked to the campaign.

To obtain a list of creator videos, use [/tto/creator/authorized/video/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-authorized-tto-media-insights/v1.3).

Note:

  • Videos that have been linked to any other TikTok Creator Marketplace campaigns or TTO Creator Marketplace campaigns are not supported.
  • The creator of the video needs to have been invited to the campaign.
| | action {Required} | string | Action to be taken.

Enum values:
  • `LINK`: Send a request to the creator for linking the video to the campaign. If such a request has been sent, the system will send a reminder notification to the creator.
    • After you send a linking request, you need to wait for 24 hours to send a reminder notification. Otherwise, an error will occur.
    • You can send up to two reminder notifications for a linking request.
  • `REVOKE`: Revoke a linking request.
    • You can only use this value when the creator has not accepted or rejected the request.
    • You can only revoke each linking request once.
| ``` ### Example #### Send a linking request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/campaign/link/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "tto_tcm_account_id": "{{tto_tcm_account_id}}", "video_id": "{{video_id}}", "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "action": "LINK" }' (/code) ``` #### Revoke a linking request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/campaign/link/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "tto_tcm_account_id": "{{tto_tcm_account_id}}", "video_id": "{{video_id}}", "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "action": "REVOKE" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{32%}|Type{15%}|Description{53%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| video_id | string | The ID of the creator video to be linked to the campaign. | #| status | string | The status of the request.

Enum values:
  • `IN_REVIEW`: Sent to the creator and pending the creator's acceptance or rejection.
  • `REVOKE`: Revoked.
| #| last_reminded_timestamp | string | The last time when the linking request or the reminder notification was sent to the creator, in [ISO-8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

Example: `2025-01-01T00:00:01Z`. | #| number_of_requests | integer | The number of linking requests that you have sent for the video.

Example: 1. | #| campaign_type | string | The type of the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign.

Enum values:
  • `CAMPAIGN`: A campaign with a [campaign-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Campaign-level%20invite%20link).
  • `BRAND_LINK`: A campaign with a [brand-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Brand-level%20invite%20link).
| ``` ### Example #### Send a linking request ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "last_reminded_timestamp": "2025-02-07T21:44:56Z", "number_of_requests": 1, "status": "IN_REVIEW", "campaign_type": "CAMPAIGN", "video_id": "{{video_id}}" } } (/code) ``` #### Revoke a linking request ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "last_reminded_timestamp": "2025-02-07T21:12:44Z", "number_of_requests": 1, "status": "REVOKE", "campaign_type": "CAMPAIGN", "video_id": "{{video_id}}" } } (/code) ```
